title: HONOR THE BODY
hookText: The one car you can never replace
openLoop: By the end: the one thing God never does to what He builds

teasers.text: Still ahead: why you can't improve on God's design
Still ahead: what your body is really worth

recap.title: Honor the Body
items: Your body belongs to God — you're not the owner
You are God's workmanship, crafted on purpose
Nothing about you is a mistake or a mis-print
A steward asks 'how does this serve God?'
So honor the body: it carries your assignment

scenes.point: Your body isn't yours — it belongs to God
You are God's workmanship — crafted, not random
He made you exactly right for what you're here to do
